allow: PowerShell(foreach \($c in 'node','pnpm','npm','git','supabase','docker'\) { $p = \(Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); if \($p\) { "$c : " + \(& $c --version 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1\) } else { "$c : NOT FOUND" } })

PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach \($c in $conns\) { Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "killed PID $\($c.OwningProcess\)" }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; if \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { "PORT STILL BUSY" } else { "port 3000 free" })
